dataSourceInstructions:
FINANCIAL YEAR IS THE DEFAULT REPORTING CALENDAR.
A year means the financial year STARTING in that year:
2022 = 01-04-2022 to 31-03-2023.
2023 = 01-04-2023 to 31-03-2024.
Apply this interpretation to every year unless calendar year is explicitly requested.

Historical years use complete April-March periods.
Current-year actuals use April through the reporting cutoff.
Current-year comparisons use equivalent elapsed financial-year periods.

Filter underlying dates from 1 April, not 1 January.
Never filter financial years using YEAR(InvoiceDate) alone.
FinancialYearStart = YEAR(DATEADD(month,-3,InvoiceDate)).
FinancialMonth = MONTH(DATEADD(month,-3,InvoiceDate)).
Group by FinancialYearStart and FinancialMonth.
Sort monthly results by FinancialMonth: April first, March last.
Use financial-year labels in answers, table columns, and chart series.
